text:
maya (People Ops): Quick heads-up — we want to run a 2-week "Redwood Cheers" microgrant push next month to surface small spot awards (peer-nominated $25 e-gifts + sticker pack). Looking for owners: nomination form, payout flow, kit fulfillment. Can anyone pick up logistics? :tada:
kelly (Events): I can own kits — sticker packs + a printed 'cheers' card. Should we include a digital thank-you note template?
maya (People Ops): Yes please. Also need help deciding payout: Amazon e-gift vs prepaid card. Bonus if payouts can go out same week nominations close.
jorge (Finance): Budget check — what’s the expected headcount? If we estimate 150 awards at $25 = $3,750 + $250 kits = ~$4k. I can provision a $5k misc GL for this if People Ops confirms. Need a quick PO or charge code.
sam (People Ops Intern): I can build the Google Form + sheet and wire up auto-notify to the people-ops channel. Happy to draft email copy.
maya (People Ops): Awesome. Kelly — can you share vendor leads and per-kit cost by EOD Friday? Also we need a ship-to opt-in for remote folks.
kelly (Events): Will do. Two vendor options: small-run sticker vendor (lead time 5 days) or swag partner (min order 100, 10 business days). Price estimates: sticker-only $2/kit, swag partner $5/kit.
jorge (Finance): Confirming we prefer electronic payment for awards — easier for accounting. If we use Amazon e-gift codes, Finance needs the bulk invoice or the list of recipients for 1099 friendliness. Are these taxable? small stipend, below threshold, but check with payroll.
maya (People Ops): Noted. I'll check with payroll for tax handling. For now assume non-taxable recognition but will confirm.
rewards-bot: Allocation approved: People Ops misc GL 540-REDWOOD-CHEERS allocated $5,000 by Finance (jorge).
kelly (Events): Drafted two kit options. Will attach price spreadsheet later. Also thinking of a tiny surprise: a printed mini postcard that says "You made someone's day". Thoughts? :smile:
sam (People Ops Intern): Nomination form draft idea (short):
```
- Your name (optional)
- Nominee name (required)
- Short reason (1-2 sentences)
- Preferred email for e-gift (required)
- Ship-to address (optional, if physical kit wanted)
```
I can add an internal checkbox for manager approval if needed.
maya (People Ops): Keep it lightweight — no manager approval required for <$50 awards. Good idea to make nominator optional to keep peer surprise.
jorge (Finance): For payouts: recommend collecting recipient email and issuing bulk e-gifts via vendor so we have a single invoice. If physical kits included, we need addresses and a shipping opt-in.
maya (People Ops): Timeline proposal: nominations open Mon Apr 6 - Fri Apr 17 (2 weeks). Awards sent the week of Apr 20. Does that work?
kelly (Events): Timeline works if vendors confirmed by Apr 10. I can fast-track sticker-only option if needed.
sam (People Ops Intern): I'll have the form + notification flow ready by Apr 3 for review.
maya (People Ops): Perfect. Action items:
- kelly: vendor quotes + per-kit cost by EOD Fri (assigned)
- sam: form + sheet + Slack notifier by Apr 3 (assigned)
- jorge: GL set to 540-REDWOOD-CHEERS and confirm tax guidance with payroll (assigned)
- maya: draft announcement copy and thank-you template (assigned)
Please react with :thumbsup: if you’re good with those tasks.
kelly (Events): :thumbsup:
sam (People Ops Intern): :thumbsup:
jorge (Finance): :thumbsup:
maya (People Ops): Thanks team — will post the announcement once form reviewed. Keeping it casual, high-signal. :)
kelly (Events): One more Q: can we do manager-wide nominations (team-level) or only peer-to-peer?
maya (People Ops): For this first run, keep it peer-to-peer only to encourage cross-team recognition. We can expand next quarter.
rewards-bot: Reminder scheduled: notification to #people-ops on 1779004444 (Apr 3) to review form.
maya (People Ops): Great. Closing loop — I'll follow up with payroll and post a short checklist tomorrow.
